title: Re-export the Apple Development cert and re-set its two repo secrets (owner act)
why: The earlier commands set the repo secret ASC_DEV_CERT_P12 empty twice: first the command ran in the wrong folder, then the file was gone, and a pipe hid the error. The TestFlight identity step cannot pass its dry run on an empty P12.
note: Owner act, waits on the owner (coordinator, 2026-11-15 19:05 CST). The owner re-exports the Apple Development cert from Keychain Access as dev.p12, then re-sets repo secrets ASC_DEV_CERT_P12 and ASC_DEV_CERT_PASSWORD with a guarded command that stops on an error. No secret value goes in any record. Related: lane testflight-identity and PR 344 (fail on an empty P12). After both land, the coordinator dispatches one dry run and the lane reads its log. Parent step: testflight-from-ci.
